summary: Narrow wooded lane with no verge and no parked cars to pull into.
reasons: Trees hard against lane, no pull-off

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush both sides, but the first 40 m runs past houses 20 to 31 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow bitumen lane with tree canopy and bank right at the edge; no clear ground beside it for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane, but a van would sit in the lane.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along it; no parking convention.

flags: Steep: about 7.7% mean, 18.6% max, over 12% for the first 60 m
Low-lying: down to 4.7 m, Cubberla Creek 80 m away
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over most of the lane.
